requirements.quote: run delegated advocate searches (Madras HC advocate or enrolment search, KHC list by name or BRN, eCourts advocate search) for the last 30 to 90 days and upcoming lists, then build proposed matters and proceedings.

`apps/web` onboarding: identifiers, then courts, then a live progress view ("found 38 listings in 3 courts"), then the one confirm grid (approve, merge, split; existing UJ-1 grid), then the court-day view.
Name disambiguation: common names are confirmed by enrolment number or BRN and by sample matters before anything is saved.
Instrumentation: time to first court-day view, and matters discovered against matters confirmed.
An advocate with identifiers at both launch High Courts reaches a populated court-day view in under 10 minutes in staging fixtures. [type:e2e]
requirements.evidence: Playwright e2e runs in CI (ship PRs and nightly), never locally per CLAUDE.md; the in-lane fixture-driven integration test covers the flow offline.

requirements.quote: Nothing is saved before the confirm grid; discovered matters carry provenance. [type:integration]
Ambiguous names prompt for disambiguation, never a silent merge. [type:unit]

requirements.why: This change records the activation steps and logs discovered/confirmed counts; a persisted metric and a Growth page panel is separate admin work.

deliverables.change: New discoverAdvocateCases(deps,input): per-court DiscoverySource ports fetched via the governed fetcher with delegatedFor, parsed in memory, matched with createAdvocateMatcher (exact only), staged as proposals only (no matter-graph writes), returns progress counts, skipped uncleared courts, provenance on each draft, and needsDisambiguation for name-only/ambiguous identifiers (no staging until confirmed). Window 30-90 days back plus upcoming.
Public index exporting the discovery API.
Unit/integration tests with mock fetcher: advocate search per court, ambiguity prompts, nothing in matter graph before apply, provenance, uncleared source skipped, counts logged.
Register the onboarding domain and its allowed imports (import, automation, sources, court via index only).
Only if the guard test lists domains: add onboarding to the expected list.
Register each new runtime export of @causedeck/core (SERVICE_TESTS with real case, or NOT_A_SERVICE with reason) .
Cross-tenant cases for the registered discovery services (B on A denied/sees nothing; A unchanged).

New migration (timestamp naming like 20261024182641_activation_event.sql, regenerated meta snapshot) seeding uncleared advocate-search source rows for Madras HC, KHC and eCourts, kind court, captcha only via delegated lookup; if the migration dir needs a root-table test update, update packages/db/src/index.test.ts.

workspaceAction server actions: start discovery, poll progress, confirm disambiguation, feeding the existing import plan actions; record identifiers_entered, discovery_found, confirm_grid_done, first_court_day_view via recordActivation (never failing the action) and log discovered vs confirmed counts.
Server page plus client steps (identifiers, courts, live progress, disambiguation, existing confirm-grid, redirect to court-day view); also loading.tsx and error.tsx beside it.
Add ACTIONS entries and probe inputs for each new 'use server' action.
Add an onboarding-discovery namespace (en/kn/ta JSON under packages/i18n/src/messages/*/) and update packages/i18n/src/__tests__/catalog.test.ts (and generated types if checked in).

preserve.what: Existing import actions and plan semantics: apps/web/app/(app)/w/[slug]/import/actions.ts and packages/core/src/import/{bootstrap,apply,plan-edit}.ts; nothing reaches the matter graph before applyImportPlan.
createWorkspaceAction behaviour and the /onboarding workspace creation page (apps/web/app/(app)/onboarding/*), including its workspace_created activation record.

Matched-only/exact-match rule in packages/core/src/import/identifiers.ts and court/list-watch.ts; fail-closed sourcing via policyFor in packages/core/src/sources; fetch layer contracts in packages/fetch/src/types.ts.
Activation steps list in packages/db/src/schema/activation.ts (no new step unless the check constraint migration is added).

decisions.choice: Discovery is built on injected DiscoverySource/fetcher ports rather than hard-wiring adapters.
decisions.justification: Same structural-port pattern as court/list-watch.ts:181 (ListFetcher) and case-watch/lookup.ts:53 (StatusFetcher), which keeps domains acyclic and tests offline.

decisions.choice: Stage discovered matters as proposals and reuse buildImportPlan/applyImportPlan and the existing confirm grid.
decisions.justification: import/bootstrap.ts:317 and import/apply.ts:122 already guarantee nothing is written before apply; list-watch.ts stages through submitProposals.
policyFor fails closed and D-048 requires DPDP clearance before production fetches (issue #479 context).
